offering_chatbotRagIa.name: AI RAG Chatbot
offering_chatbotRagIa.tagline: Virtual assistant that understands your business
offering_chatbotRagIa.description: Conversational bot trained on your knowledge base. Buy it as custom software (we hand over the code) or subscribe to the monthly SaaS hosted by us.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with limited scope
basico.idealPara: SMBs with up to 5,000 conversations per month
incluye: Subtle KopTup branding on the widget
Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.description: For SMBs with an active customer service team
profesional.idealPara: Teams with 10–30 agents handling 25k conversations per month
incluye: Up to 5 knowledge sources with scheduled retraining
Metrics dashboard with CSAT and top topics

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with steady traffic and automatable processes
incluye: Up to 25 sources with hourly auto-sync
Configurable workflows and A/B testing of replies
Executive reports and Data Warehouse exports
Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with multiple verticals and compliance requirements
incluye: Multi-tenant for multiple brands or business units
Architecture aligned with HIPAA/SOC 2/ISO 27001 (certification at customer expense)
PM + tech lead assigned during rollout
Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium
Monthly executive reports for your committee

offering_chatbotRagIa.costoNote: OpenAI/Anthropic costs (~$80–$4,500 USD/mo by usage) and hosting/vector DB (~$50–$10,000 USD/mo) are billed by the provider directly to the customer.
